_note: Hand-written from the 2 x 2 lit previews and contact sheets (2026-11-24). The 'expect' lists are guesses from parameter names unless the catalogue's tests/effects.json proves them.

bronze_polished.look: Flat tan bronze, almost no relief, a few small dark spots.

cathedral_limestone_wall.look: Grey limestone ashlar in running bond, many small blocks with pale chiselled edges and hammered faces; busy, rough relief.

cinderblock_wall.look: Smooth blue-grey blocks in running bond (4 x 8), straight dark joints, soft mottling; very clean.

concrete_wall.look: Brown-grey fine sandy concrete, evenly grainy, no joints.

cotton_tricotine_weave_front_side.look: Beige woven cotton twill; fine diagonal weave, only readable at pixel scale.

creased_brick_wall.look: Red-brown small fired bricks in running bond, thin mortar, varied tone and chips.

dirty_wood_planks.look: Brown horizontal weathered planks with dark gaps and worn grain.

gold_natural.look: Yellow gold with a hammered or mottled surface.

granite_wall_tile.look: Dark charcoal granite slabs with pale marble inclusions in a repeating cluster pattern; flat faces, thin gaps, busy colour.

iron_forged.look: Near-black forged iron with a fine hammered grain.

large_cliff_smooth_chalk.look: Pale grey-white chalk with sharp craggy cliff relief and dust; the name says smooth but the default relief is rough and strong.

large_limestone_tiles.look: Brown sandstone-like slabs in an irregular grid with thin dark joints; rough pitted faces.

leather_bull.look: Dark red-brown leather with a fine pebble grain.

limestone_floor.look: Grey-beige square limestone pavers with wide soft grout lines and mild face texture.

medieval_castle_wall.look: Yellow-brown rubble ashlar with green moss and lichen, cracked blocks, drips; rough and busy.

painted_wood_board.look: Dark brown vertical boards with worn paint.

patinated_wood_planks.look: Orange-brown planks with knots and dark seams.

rectangle_stone_tiles_wall.look: Flat terracotta-red rectangular tiles in a neat grid with hairline joints; very smooth, but the colour is red.

sandblasted_gold.look: Flat pale gold, soft cloudy tone, no relief.

slate_tile.look: Dark charcoal slate shingles in staggered rows with fine joints.

slick_stone_wall.look: Warm grey-brown continuous rock face with soft rounded lumps and shallow pits; no joints; worn rather than glassy.

small_stone_tiles.look: Small grey square tiles in a tight grid with dark joints; fine grainy faces.

smoothed_limestone_rock_surface.look: Brown-grey continuous limestone with soft worn lumps and fine speckles; no joints, no block pattern; the only structural controls are relief and colour.

stacked_stone_wall.look: Dry-stacked rubble in grey-brown with orange tints; many small irregular stones, deep joints; rough.

stone_crumble.look: Light grey fine-grained crumbly stone with small pits; no joints; relief is fine noise.
stone_crumble.smooth: fine grain, rough at normal scale

stylized_random_ashlar_floor.look: Stylised flat slabs of random polygon shape on a tan base, cracks between; cartoon-like.

tool_carved_stone.look: Cream-beige stone with horizontal chisel streaks and pale blotches; no joints.

urban_stone_tiles.look: Dark grey cobble setts of mixed tone, rounded, tight joints.

victorian_wood_ceiling.look: Brown hexagonal coffered ceiling panels with gold edge trim.

walkway_stone_tiles_03.look: Dark grey-green concrete slabs in a grid with thin joints; flat, fine pitted faces.

weathered_wood_floor.look: Grey-brown horizontal floor boards with nail heads.

wood_black_walnut_striped.look: Reddish-brown walnut with wavy dark grain stripes.

wood_wenge.look: Very dark brown wenge with fine straight grain.
